extZaloPersonal.capture.bothSides: From that same moment your own replies go in too, not only what the other person writes. When you answer from Zalo on your phone or Zalo PC, Zalo sends us that message the way it sends it to your other devices — nothing here reads your phone — so a conversation reads as a conversation and not one half of one. A reply you send from the CRM is saved once, not twice.
extZaloPersonal.capture.chooseFirst: Pick one of the two above, and then name the people it needs.
extZaloPersonal.capture.emptyChosen: Nobody is on the list yet, so nothing goes into the CRM.
extZaloPersonal.capture.emptyEveryone: Nobody is left out yet, so every conversation would go into the CRM.
extZaloPersonal.capture.forward: Nothing changes until you press save. From that moment on, new messages go into the CRM — your earlier conversations are not fetched, because Zalo does not hand them over.
extZaloPersonal.capture.modeEveryone: Everyone I talk to — except the people I leave out
extZaloPersonal.capture.noRoster: Zalo did not answer just now, so searching will not find anybody new. The people already on your list are below; you can still take any of them off and save as usual.
extZaloPersonal.capture.now: Going into the CRM right now
extZaloPersonal.capture.nowExceptNote: except the people on the list below
extZaloPersonal.capture.nowNone: Nothing yet — nothing is saved until you press save.
extZaloPersonal.capture.nowNothing: Nothing — you have not chosen yet
extZaloPersonal.capture.pickerChosen: Search your Zalo contacts to add somebody…
extZaloPersonal.capture.pickerEveryone: Search your Zalo contacts to leave somebody out…
extZaloPersonal.capture.saveFailed: Your changes may not have been saved. Check the list above before trying again.
extZaloPersonal.capture.sub: Your call, and yours alone. Nobody else sets this up for you, and you can change it whenever you like.
extZaloPersonal.capture.title: Which Zalo conversations go into the CRM?
extZaloPersonal.capture.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
extZaloPersonal.capture.warnEveryone: This puts every conversation on your personal Zalo into the company CRM — your family, your friends, your doctor, anybody who is not a customer — until you add them to the leave-out list below. Colleagues who can open the CRM can read those chats too.
extZaloPersonal.capture.yours: This stays yours: change it or take it back whenever you like, and disconnecting the account on this page stops everything at once.
extZaloPersonal.connect.checkFailed: We could not check how the login is going. Start over to get a new code.
extZaloPersonal.connect.declined: The login was turned down on the phone. Start over if that was not what you meant.
extZaloPersonal.connect.expired: This code expired before it was scanned. Start over to get a new one.
extZaloPersonal.connect.how: Open Zalo on your phone, tap the QR scanner, and scan this code.
extZaloPersonal.connect.qrAlt: QR code to scan with Zalo on your phone
extZaloPersonal.connect.startFailed: The login could not be started. Try again in a moment.
extZaloPersonal.connect.waiting: Waiting for you to scan the code.
extZaloPersonal.connection.captureNote: You choose what goes in, just below. New messages only, from the moment you save — earlier ones are not fetched.
extZaloPersonal.connection.disconnectFai: Your account may still be connected. Check the state above before trying again.
extZaloPersonal.connection.needsReconnec: Zalo stopped accepting this connection, so nothing is being captured. Scan a new code with your phone to take it up again.
extZaloPersonal.connection.stranded: A sign-in did not finish, and the Zalo access it created is still held by this installation. Nothing is being captured with it, but the access is real — remove it here, then connect again if you meant to.
extZaloPersonal.connection.sub: Your own personal account. Your Zalo login stays on your phone — it is never shown here, and this screen never asks for it.
extZaloPersonal.connection.title: Your Zalo account
extZaloPersonal.consent.capture: Nothing from your Zalo goes into the CRM until you say so. Connecting only links the account; afterwards you choose one of two things — everyone you talk to except the people you leave out, or only the people you pick.
extZaloPersonal.consent.noHistory: Messages start going into the CRM the moment you save that choice, and only from then on. Zalo does not hand over your past conversations, so nothing from before today will appear — only messages that arrive from now on, plus whatever Zalo was still holding for you.
extZaloPersonal.consent.personal: This is your own personal account, not a company one. The choices are yours to change or take back, and you can disconnect the account here whenever you like — capture stops the moment you do.
extZaloPersonal.consent.title: Before you connect
extZaloPersonal.consent.zaloWeb: While this is connected, use Zalo on your phone rather than Zalo Web. Zalo Web signs in as the same account, and the two sessions push each other out — which costs you another scan. Your phone is fine alongside it; it is Zalo Web specifically.
extZaloPersonal.noGrant: You have not been granted access to this connector.
extZaloPersonal.sub: Connect the Zalo account on your phone, so the conversations you allow land on the CRM timeline and you can reply from here.
extZaloPersonal.title: Zalo (your own account)
